findings.title: Re-bless does not enforce the per-tick check
findings.claim: The blessing and re-blessing commands can succeed without a successful canonical-trace check after the version bump.
findings.why: If `check` is skipped, `golden` permits changed hashes and digests, while the fixture re-blesser compares sampled fields and boundaries. A gameplay change between samples can therefore be blessed in the wrong order.
findings.fix: Make the blessing and fixture re-bless paths require a successful per-tick comparison against the pre-bump baseline before either writes.

findings.title: The aggregate gate can mask a skipped seed test
findings.claim: When a per-seed test has not run, the aggregate test silently runs that seed without applying its weapon, cap, or planet-end assertions.
findings.why: The suite can report a passing aggregate gate even though one seed's required per-seed checks were skipped.
findings.fix: Remove the fallback in the aggregate test and assert that results from all ten per-seed tests are present.

findings.title: Gate duels ignore rejected scripted commands
findings.claim: The ten-seed runner discards command results; admission is asserted only for seed 4 in a separate test.
findings.why: A seed-specific rejected command could leave all telemetry thresholds passing, concealing a violation of the scripted pair's command requirement.
findings.fix: Assert that every scripted command result is applied inside `runDuel`, so all gate seeds check admission.
